hooks.command: PATH="/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin${PATH:+:$PATH}"; export PATH; for required in git bash; do if ! command -v "$required" >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "BLOCKED: required executable unavailable: $required" >&2; exit 2; fi; done; guard_rel=".claude/hooks/guard-collaborative-git.sh"; git_root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)"; env_root="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-}"; if [ -z "$git_root" ] && [ -z "$env_root" ]; then echo "BLOCKED: unable to resolve the Git repository root." >&2; exit 2; fi; guard_path=""; for candidate_root in "$git_root" "$env_root"; do if [ -n "$candidate_root" ] && [ -f "$candidate_root/$guard_rel" ] && [ -r "$candidate_root/$guard_rel" ]; then guard_path="$candidate_root/$guard_rel"; break; fi; done; if [ -z "$guard_path" ]; then echo "BLOCKED: required guard unavailable: $guard_rel" >&2; exit 2; fi; exec bash "$guard_path"

PATH="/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin${PATH:+:$PATH}"; export PATH; for required in git bash; do if ! command -v "$required" >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "BLOCKED: required executable unavailable: $required" >&2; exit 2; fi; done; guard_rel=".claude/hooks/guard-protected-paths.sh"; git_root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)"; env_root="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-}"; if [ -n "$git_root" ]; then guard_root="$git_root"; else guard_root="$env_root"; fi; if [ -z "$guard_root" ]; then echo "BLOCKED: unable to resolve the Git repository root." >&2; exit 2; fi; guard_path="$guard_root/$guard_rel"; if [ ! -f "$guard_path" ] && [ -n "$git_root" ] && [ -n "$env_root" ]; then here_common=""; session_common=""; common="$(git -C "$git_root" rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir 2>/dev/null)" && [ -n "$common" ] && here_common="$(CDPATH= cd -P -- "$common" 2>/dev/null && pwd -P)"; common="$(git -C "$env_root" rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir 2>/dev/null)" && [ -n "$common" ] && session_common="$(CDPATH= cd -P -- "$common" 2>/dev/null && pwd -P)"; if [ -n "$here_common" ] && [ -n "$session_common" ] && [ "$here_common" != "$session_common" ]; then guard_path="$env_root/$guard_rel"; fi; fi; if [ ! -f "$guard_path" ] || [ ! -r "$guard_path" ]; then echo "BLOCKED: required guard unavailable: $guard_rel" >&2; exit 2; fi; exec bash "$guard_path"
